selection_rationale: M809-01 remains frozen and M809-06 is killed in its ordinary additive form. The graph-realizability attack resolves the abstract ownership ambiguity: in a real B-opposite repeated colour, the two inner endpoints form a forced missing A edge, and these owned diagonal atoms inject within a coherent star. The former path-shaped empty-ownership pair cannot be a canonical full-reserve graph. However, a fully checked n=14,e=50,L4(2),rainbow-C7 maximum-witness B-opposite graph realizes a genuine three-colour/two-B-token tight circuit together with three distinct owned A atoms. Thus C7 does not eliminate the circuit and A atoms are not fungible B capacity. M809-11 remains the sole survivor only as a typed nonlinear conversion theorem from the owned diagonal/whole A rectangle to S_m or new B reserve, with cross-star overlap control; no existing ledger proves that conversion.
